headline.text: L3 ML4 peppermint trial hit *6 separate issues* overnight, while shroud shortage paused MFM quarter-pallet run until Tuesday

per_plant_summary.L1: Caramel lines ran mostly clean. S2 label and metal-detector issues cleared by mid-shift. S4 Theegarten motor swap completed; belt peeling addressed and ATP-passed. S3 reject-box overflow flagged but not yet resolved.
per_plant_summary.L2: Moulding ran steady. ML2 PTL pressure resolved after bottom-handle adjustment; sweco screen swap fixed salt clogging. ML3 accumulator belts replaced. One hand-pack belt failed ATP and cannot be disassembled—still open.
per_plant_summary.L3: Heavy trial activity on ML4 for Unreal peppermint—ingredient tank, cold stamp, plastic shavings, and demolding errors all cleared by shift end. MFM quarter-pallet run paused at 10:48 due to shroud shortage; supplier delivery expected Tuesday. Cavanna setting changes recurring for third time this week.

notes.text: Quality team collected extensive trial data on ML4—weight, viscosity, organoleptic checks all documented for Unreal review.
FFS seal-bar cleaning revealed heavy product buildup that may explain recent double-bag issues.
Case labels for quarter pallets clarified—one license plate per four-unit stack, placed top-right corner facing out.

resolved.title: S2 label wrinkled, then printing over text
resolved.summary: Labeler producing wrinkled labels; after fix, printer positioned too close and overprinting.
resolved.resolution: Cleared by 10:04—Troy corrected wrinkle issue, moved to Labeler B setup, working (Troy Baxter).

resolved.title: S2 melting tank lid screw broke
resolved.summary: Bolt sheared on melting tank #1 cover; second piece unaccounted for initially.
resolved.resolution: Cleared by 10:11—both pieces accounted for, Justin Garner confirmed (Justin Garner, Victor Romero Sr. at 14:30).

resolved.title: S2 metal detector repeatedly stopping line
resolved.summary: MD belt triggering false rejects; line pausing frequently.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 15:30—Caleb York added slight belt tension, spike from extension cleared; salt under belt noted (Caleb York).

resolved.title: S4 Theegarten belt surface peeling
resolved.summary: Belt #1 and #2 showing surface degradation; unclear when peeling started.
resolved.resolution: Addressed by 05:17—maintenance removed peeled areas, smoothed surface; cleaned, swabbed, ATP passed at result 11 (Mariela Gudino).

resolved.title: S2 individual weight running high
resolved.summary: Piece weight at 24g against 23g spec; operator notified to adjust.
resolved.resolution: Corrected by 08:22—adjustment made, waiting for product to verify (Nancy Quiroz).

resolved.title: S4 missing screw found during belt walk
resolved.summary: Loose screw discovered with unknown origin; stored for identification.
resolved.resolution: Returned by 17:42—Caleb York identified as bottom back corner of safety latch assembly, reinstalled (Caleb York).

resolved.title: ML2 high PTL pressure, no sweco flow
resolved.summary: Post-cleaning startup showing excessive pressure on PTL system; no material reaching sweco.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 00:48—bottom handle set in wrong position with loose set screw; repositioned and tightened, flow restored (Gustavo Rodas).

resolved.title: ML2 salt clogging sweco screen
resolved.summary: Sea-salt application plugging filter screen; needed different mesh size.
resolved.resolution: Resolved by 04:00—swapped to 6M mesh after consultation with Hervin Herrera, good flow achieved (Gustavo Rodas).

resolved.title: ML3 Z-conveyor stopped working
resolved.summary: Conveyor fault with maintenance troubleshooting; line continued running.
resolved.resolution: Cleared same shift—line still running per Alex message 12:08; no follow-up downtime reported.

resolved.title: ML3 accumulator bad belts
resolved.summary: Two belts damaged on accumulation line; replacement and cleaning required.
resolved.resolution: Completed by 23:36—Fernando replaced belts, cleaned area, reported good to go (Fernando Flores).

resolved.title: FFS seal bars full of product buildup
resolved.summary: Heavy chocolate accumulation between blade and seal bars; potential cause of double-bag defects.
resolved.resolution: Cleaned by 03:38—Fernando removed seal bars and blade, cleared product buildup from both sides (Fernando Flores).

resolved.title: ML4 depositor 2 wrong sliders installed
resolved.summary: Depositor running with incorrect slider set during peppermint trial setup.
resolved.resolution: Correct peppermint crème sliders located and installed by 09:01 (Itzel Chavez).

resolved.title: ML4 ingredient tank not pumping cream to hopper
resolved.summary: Automated cream feed failing during trial; maintenance troubleshooting pump and agitator connection.
resolved.resolution: Cleared by 00:01—Kavin Ayala completed electrical troubleshooting, verified pump operation, tank now working in auto mode.

resolved.title: Plastic shavings from mold scraper
resolved.summary: Plastic debris found on product during ML4 trial; source traced to side-of-mold scraper damaging molds.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 17:07—Spencer made scraper adjustments, bin cleaned, QA collected FM samples, line restarted (Shane Olsen).

resolved.title: Truffle X-ray false positives since 04:00
resolved.summary: Metal detector rejecting product repeatedly with no actual contamination found; team investigated sensitivity settings and confirmed no hold required.
resolved.resolution: Cleared by 05:48—team confirmed no metal on product, passed quality checks, identified likely source as object near detector per Shawn Jewkes.

resolved.title: ML4 demolding belt control timeout repeating
resolved.summary: Demolding section throwing repeated belt-control faults; maintenance called multiple times as line continued to stop.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 06:02—Kavin Ayala adjusted corner block inward 1-2mm to prevent tracking collision (red corner catching green corner).

resolved.title: MFM Z-conveyor D not moving
resolved.summary: Conveyor stopped; maintenance dispatched to troubleshoot.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 06:46—fill sensor out of position, Nathan Ruiz repositioned (Nathan Ruiz).

resolved.title: ML1 incorrect product date printed
resolved.summary: Date code found in wrong format during startup check; line stopped and QA notified.
resolved.resolution: Corrected at 06:57—line stopped, correct format entered, startup checklist flagged the error (Grey Boscan).

resolved.title: MFM sensor setup off centerline marks
resolved.summary: Photo-eye sensors positioned incorrectly for new SKU; setup instructions not followed by previous shift.
resolved.resolution: Fixed by 08:15—Shawn Jewkes reset sensors to centerline marks and validated angle (Shawn Jewkes).

needs_attention.title: S3 reject boxes too small, overflowing at MM3/MM4
needs_attention.summary: Rejection bins insufficient for volume when defect count exceeds 30 pieces; causing accumulation and spillover.
needs_attention.status: Flagged to Nathan Topham at 11:47; larger boxes or alternate solution requested but no decision as of 07:15.

needs_attention.title: S3 tunnel 1 belt setting change recommended
needs_attention.summary: William Beattie recommends updating centerline from 1.7 to 1.0 to improve bed depth and reduce pecan usage variance.
needs_attention.status: Recommendation made at 19:13 to Erandy Garcilazo Ceja; Erandy committed to update tomorrow but change not yet implemented in centerline.

needs_attention.title: ML2 hand-pack belt failed ATP, cannot disassemble
needs_attention.summary: Blue hand-pack belt reading 318 RLU from chocolate residue; maintenance reports belt cannot be taken apart for deep cleaning.
needs_attention.status: Failed swab at 22:03; Hervin Herrera and Brandon Lance notified but no alternate cleaning method identified by window close.

needs_attention.title: MFM quarter-pallet run paused—shroud shortage
needs_attention.summary: Item 41082 shrouds too small and tearing on trays; BOM calls for 41107 which is shared with L1 and only 9 pallets available for both plants to finish orders.
needs_attention.status: Line paused at 10:48 after packaging material in hoppers; supplier delivery expected Tuesday 9/1 per Kirk Nickel message at 13:56.

needs_attention.title: ML4 foreign material plastic on sweco
needs_attention.summary: Different plastic texture found on sweco during trial; suspected to be from buffer-tank cleaning brushes.
needs_attention.status: Identified at 20:36 as distinct from earlier scraper shavings; texture suggests brush source but no corrective action documented.

needs_attention.title: Cavanna chicane settings changed again—3rd time this week
needs_attention.summary: Operator finding incorrect chicane numbers repeatedly; someone overwriting settings between shifts.
needs_attention.status: Nathan corrected numbers at 06:43; no root cause identified for recurring unauthorized changes.

needs_attention.title: ML1 shaker area received dirty
needs_attention.summary: Condition of shaker station unacceptable at shift handoff.
needs_attention.status: Flagged to Rich Brierley at 06:59 with photo; no confirmation of cleaning or accountability follow-up.

needs_attention.title: Truffle printer received with ink cartridge at zero
needs_attention.summary: Flow-wrap printer handed off to shift with one color depleted.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 07:08 with photo; no follow-up on cartridge replacement as of window close.
